title: Gideon needs a favor

nodes.speaker: Gideon
nodes.text: What do you want?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do you want?

nodes.speaker: Gideon
nodes.text: You have a look in your eye. Like you're hiding something.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You have a look in your eye. Like you're hiding something.

nodes.speaker: Gideon
nodes.text: The kid with the hair that looks like brains?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The kid with the hair that looks like brains?

nodes.speaker: Gideon
nodes.text: Sure I know him. Why?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure I know him. Why?

nodes.speaker: Gideon
nodes.text: I work for a lot of people, and most of them want me to respect their privacy. I'm giving you nothing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I work for a lot of people, and most of them want me to respect their privacy. I'm giving you nothing.

nodes.speaker: Gideon
nodes.text: I'm not interested in being owed. I need a favor done first.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not interested in being owed. I need a favor done first.

nodes.speaker: Gideon
nodes.text: I wouldn't be much of a bounty hunter if I didn't develop a sense for who can and who can't afford me, and you, my friend, cannot afford me. Try again

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I wouldn't be much of a bounty hunter if I didn't develop a sense for who can and who can't afford me, and you, my friend, cannot afford me. Try again

nodes.speaker: Gideon
nodes.text: It's real sweet of you to appeal to my better nature, but I don't believe in wasting anyone's time. Altruism doesn't fit me kid. Try again.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's real sweet of you to appeal to my better nature, but I don't believe in wasting anyone's time. Altruism doesn't fit me kid. Try again.

nodes.speaker: Gideon
nodes.text: Brains, yes. I know him. Why?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Brains, yes. I know him. Why?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Just to talk.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Just to talk.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I need your help.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I need your help.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Do you know Razlo?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you know Razlo?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yeah, him?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, him?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: His hair looks like...?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: His hair looks like...?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Do you work for him?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you work for him?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I could make it worth your while.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I could make it worth your while.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I could make it worth your while.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I could make it worth your while.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Like what?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Like what?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Warning: If Gideon asks you to help him, I predict it is highly likely someone else will suffer.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Warning: If Gideon asks you to help him, I predict it is highly likely someone else will suffer.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Let's just hear him out.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Let's just hear him out.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I know.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I know.

nodes.speaker: Gideon
nodes.text: I'm looking for someone. A girl that goes by the name "Mila." Anyone with a real fancy Automata might have the resources to find her...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm looking for someone. A girl that goes by the name "Mila." Anyone with a real fancy Automata might have the resources to find her...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I know you work for him.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I know you work for him.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I know you work for him.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I know you work for him.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I would owe you a favor if you helped me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I would owe you a favor if you helped me.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I would owe you a favor if you helped me.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I would owe you a favor if you helped me.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: He's dangerous. He's a threat to innocent people. Help me stop him.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He's dangerous. He's a threat to innocent people. Help me stop him.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: He's dangerous. He's a threat to innocent people. Help me stop him.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: He's dangerous. He's a threat to innocent people. Help me stop him.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What will you do with her?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What will you do with her?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What will you do with her?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What will you do with her?

nodes.speaker: Gideon
nodes.text: Just talk. Here's the deal: you help me find Mila and I'll help you with Razlo. Take it or leave it. Now get going. I got nothing else to say.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Just talk. Here's the deal: you help me find Mila and I'll help you with Razlo. Take it or leave it. Now get going. I got nothing else to say.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I have a match on a young woman named "Mila". We could find her for him... or warn her.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have a match on a young woman named "Mila". We could find her for him... or warn her.
